data.narrative:
Plantd Materials is a Series B–stage housing and construction company founded by Nathan Silvernail, Huade Tan, and Josh Dorfman, having raised $42M to date. The valuation analysis draws on a private comparables universe of four peers (Cuby Technologies, Cover, Somos, and Charge Robotics); no public housing-tech companies serve as direct comparables for this frontier segment.

Stage-progression methodology is the applicable valuation approach given available data. Using total capital raised of $42M as a valuation proxy and applying a 1.9x step-up multiplier typical of Series B to subsequent-round advancement yields an implied value of $80M. This method reflects the capital intensity and stage-based risk profile characteristic of construction-tech ventures.

The triangulated valuation range is $68M (low) to $92M (high), with a median of $80M. The 36% spread between low and high estimates reflects inherent uncertainty in a single-method analysis and the nascency of comparable valuation benchmarks in frontier construction technology. Key sensitivities include the applicability of the 1.9x multiplier to Plantd's specific growth trajectory and market dynamics within the housing-construction sector. Confidence in this range is constrained by reliance on stage-progression methodology alone; additional valuation approaches would require revenue, growth rate, or profitability data not present in the current dataset.
